the modulation of a set of motor modules (i.e. a subset of the motor units recruited during a motor task) accounts for about 70 % of participants' perceptually relevant variance.

(1) motor modules account for active force perception; (2) the CNS selects motor modules aimed at maximizing sensory input sampling; (3) the CNS selects the motor modules based on a modular organization of the motor system.
